babolat-pure-aero-98-gen8: Spin and easy power with strong serves, but many report elbow or wrist pain.
babolat-pure-aero-98-gen9: More comfortable and controlled than the last generation, though some find it muted and sluggish.
babolat-pure-drive-gen11: Easy power with a softer feel than before; arm discomfort for some, and balls fly long for others.
head-boom-pro-2024: Power, control and stability in one frame, though a couple find it clunky on a one-handed backhand.
head-gravity-pro-2023: Plush, stable feel with comfortable power; the heavy swingweight hurts some one-handed backhands.
head-gravity-tour-2025: Arm-friendly with a good sweet spot for a 98; power is modest, so it suits those who supply pace.
head-radical-mp-2023: Control racket with precision and feel, though modest power and low launch led a few to switch.
head-radical-mp-2025: Softer, arm-friendlier ride with good feel; a couple note it is less powered than the 2023.
head-speed-mp-2022: Balanced all-rounder that many say plays better than later versions; arm soreness for some.
head-speed-mp-2026: Solid, connected feel that is easy on the arm and an improvement on the 2024; a few find it heavy.
tecnifibre-t-fight-300s: Spin, manoeuvrability and power for players coming from modern frames; some added lead for stability.
tecnifibre-t-fight-305s: Quick, manoeuvrable swing with control and stability; many are bothered by the grip shape.
wilson-blade-100-v9: Forgiving, balanced frame with decent power on first serves, though a few felt it lacked character.
wilson-blade-98-16x19-v10: Spin and stability that several find more solid than the V9; a few mention a small sweet spot.
wilson-blade-98-18x20-v9: Stable, heavier swing and strong serves; depth and power take more effort, and two found it tiring.
wilson-blade-pro-100-v10: Stable yet whippy with crisp volleys and a strong serve; a couple said it needs extra weight.
wilson-blade-pro-98-16x19-v9: Heavy, feedback-rich frame for strong players, but the very high swingweight is hard to manoeuvre.
wilson-clash-100-pro-v3: Comfortable, stable and controlled for sore elbows; a couple found it unstable against big hitters.
wilson-clash-100-v3: Arm comfort that eased pain from stiffer frames, though power is modest and some find it mushy.
wilson-pro-staff-97-v14: Control and a solid feel for long-time fans of the line; some find it unforgiving or hard on arms.
wilson-shift-99-pro-v1: Spin and power from the denser pattern, though some rec players find it too much racket.
wilson-shift-99-v1: Spin-friendly with a good mix of control and power; a few found it unstable until they added lead.
wilson-ultra-99-pro-v5: Spin and easy power from an open pattern; it punishes mishits and is demanding to swing.
yonex-ezone-100-8th-gen: Easy power and a big sweet spot with comfort close to the Clash; some find the feel muted.
yonex-ezone-98-7th-gen: Control and easy power that many prefer to the newer generation; a few get arm pain.
yonex-ezone-98-8th-gen: Forgiving and easy on the arm with free power, but several dislike the muted, vague feel.
yonex-percept-100: Control and arm comfort with a bigger sweet spot than the 97; limited power means you must swing out.
yonex-percept-100d: Precise, stable and arm-friendly with more forgiveness than the 97; the main gripe is limited power.
yonex-vcore-98-7th-gen: Lots of spin and a whippy swing, though others find it underpowered, muted and hard to control.
yonex-vcore-98-8th-gen: Easy power and plenty of spin, but the high launch sends balls long and elbow trouble is common.
yonex-vcore-95-8th-gen: Stability, spin and a crisper feel than before; some find it head-heavy and demanding.
yonex-ezone-100-7th-gen: Easy power, comfort and forgiveness; a few found it too powerful or stiff.
babolat-pure-strike-97-gen4: Control and precision, including on a one-handed backhand; a couple note low launch.
wilson-blade-98-16x19-v9: Connected control frame that rewards full swings; some find it short on free power.
head-speed-pro-2024: Control and feel, especially on flat shots; one warns it is very demanding for beginners.
babolat-pure-strike-98-16x19-gen4: Control and power when swinging freely; a few get arm, wrist or elbow pain.
yonex-vcore-100d-8th-gen: Stability and plow-through for some, but many find it heavy, clunky and slow to swing.
wilson-pro-staff-rf97-autograph-v13: Stability, soft feel and precision, but several tire of its weight late in matches.
babolat-pure-drive-98-gen11: Softer, spin-friendly Pure Drive that is kinder on the arm; one finds it unforgiving off-centre.
babolat-pure-strike-98-16x19-gen3: Control and power; some find the sweet spot small, and a few had arm discomfort.
wilson-rf-01-pro: Stable on volleys and one-handers, but the sweet spot is small and the swing heavy and tiring.
babolat-pure-aero-gen9: Plenty of spin and better arm comfort than the 2023 version; some find the feel muted.
wilson-pro-staff-97-v13: Control and a crisp feel when hit cleanly, but demanding and unforgiving.
yonex-percept-97: Control and arm-friendly comfort; the main downsides are low power and how demanding it is.
yonex-vcore-95-7th-gen: Control, spin and arm comfort for big swings; a few found it too muted.
wilson-rf-01: Manoeuvrability, control and touch; the sweet spot is small, and some add weight.
head-speed-tour-2026: Controlled, stable and comfortable with low power; several found it demanding.
wilson-clash-100-v2: Known for arm comfort and a large, forgiving sweet spot; it feels muted.
prince-ats-textreme-tour-98: Powerful, well-balanced all-rounder with great feel; a couple find it a bit clubby.
tecnifibre-t-fight-300-iso: Stability, spin and comfort; a few found it muted.
dunlop-sx-300-tour-2022: Easy spin and power, though a few find it launchy on returns.
tecnifibre-t-fight-305-iso: Control and serve power, but it is heavy, hard to swing and tiring after a set for some.
yonex-vcore-100-8th-gen: Reviews split: some like the whippy spin, others find it dampened and slow.
head-boom-pro-2026: Power, serve and spin without losing much control; two found it top-heavy.
yonex-percept-97d: Control for those who make their own pace, but it is unforgiving.
tecnifibre-t-fight-315s: Whippy, manoeuvrable and easy to use; a few prefer it to the RF01 Pro.
wilson-blade-100-v10: Control with more forgiveness and a little more power than the 98; a couple wanted more power.
yonex-muse-100: Very comfortable, soft and forgiving for players coming back from arm trouble.
